data.name: SkillAuthoring_Guide
data.value: Write a skill that follows the Agent Skills standard: - name: 1-64 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (no double hyphens and none at the edges), in verb-noun form. - description: 1-1024 characters, in the third person: what it does and WHEN to use it ("USE FOR: ...") and when not to ("DO NOT USE FOR: ..."), using the words a user would use. No XML tags. - instructions (Markdown, ideally 200-2500 tokens): title, purpose, inputs, workflow in numbered steps, concrete examples in code blocks, validation criteria and common mistakes. Write actionable instructions, not theory; include only what a capable model would not know on its own. - references: long or occasionally needed material in separate files (references/x.md), linked from the instructions with relative paths one level deep.
